body: Phase 10e of PLAN.md and H5 of docs/headless-cli-plan.md. The brief ends with a `Tools:` line naming the form in use (MCP or CLI with --json). `sati rules --cli-only` writes the rules block for agents without MCP. `docs/guide/headless.md`, a README section, completions checked. Close the Phase 10 gate.

completion.releaseNote: The brief names the tool form to use, and `sati rules sync --cli-only` writes rules for agents with no MCP client.
completion.summary: Phase 10e (H5). The brief ends with a Tools line: `Tools: MCP.` from the MCP server and the session-start hook, `Tools: CLI (--json on every command)…` from `sati brief` (new `--tools mcp|cli`). `sati rules sync --cli-only` writes the rules block as commands, adds no MCP configs, and later syncs keep that form (`--no-cli-only` reverts). New guide docs/guide/headless.md, README section, PLAN.md 10e ticked, plan doc status done, progress entry, ideas, changeset. pty-run.py no longer takes an answered question's redraw for the next prompt (fixed two flakes). Verified: build, lint, typecheck, unit tests (core 376, cli 279 + 3 skipped as before, mcp 32, store 92, sync 57, ui 40), Playwright 97. Not done: screen-reader pass; `init --cli-only` (ideas).
